---
title: "Update Your SASA Profile"
---

If you are already a SASA member and would like to update your details with SASA, including:

- your contact information,
- sign up for additional Interest Groups or Chapters,
- your profile picture and permissions,

please follow the instructions below:

1. Navigate and sign in to your [Glue Up Profile](https://app.glueup.com/org/sastat/memberships).
2. Select **MEMBERSHIPS** on the left hand side of the screen.
3. Select **VIEW MEMBERSHIP DETAILS**.
4. Select **UPDATE MY MEMBER PROFILE**.
5. Update your details and/or change your interest groups.
6. Click **SAVE**.

[Go to Glue Up](https://app.glueup.com/org/sastat/memberships){.btn-sasa}
